pattern_alerts:
PATTERN 1 — LONG-side failure in a below-EMA300 market (VERIFIED, PostgreSQL, meta_rsi):
Window 24h, n=9 closed (LONG n=7, SHORT n=2). LONG = -0.40 USDT, 14% WR. SHORT = +0.07 USDT, 50% WR. Losers by meta_rsi: POL -0.22 (53.6), STX -0.11 (57.6), NEO -0.05 (52.6), CFX SHORT -0.04 (51.2), BTC -0.04 (55.7), SOL -0.02 (32.7). Every losing LONG sat at meta_rsi 50-58 except SOL at 32.7.
WINNING SIDE: shorting the same coins, or flat. STX fell a further -1.1% after our long; POL and NEO kept drifting down; BTC was under EMA300 for the entire hold so the winning side was SHORT the bounce; SOL's oversold long bought a knife that did not bounce.
WHY WEREN'T WE ON IT: entries were mid-band LONGs during a 20h BTC downtrend — the tape was already telling us the direction and we took the counter-side. Small n (9) — direction of the finding is strong, magnitude is not; re-check at the next 24h boundary.

PATTERN 2 — hard_max_loss chop entries vs trail winners (VERIFIED, 72h, n=63):
LONG profit-monster-trail n=17 = +0.93 USDT. LONG hard_max_loss n=9 = -1.21 USDT. LONG atr_sl_hit n=10 = -0.40. Net 72h LONG = 49 trades, -0.84, 35% WR; SHORT = 14 trades, -0.34, 21% WR.
WINNING SIDE: on the 9 hard_max_loss trades, the winning side was not being in them (or shorting the fade) — none reached +0.40% for trail to arm, so the entry itself was wrong, not the exit. The 17 trail exits prove our LONG machinery pays when the entry is a trend start rather than a chop tick.
WHY WEREN'T WE ON IT: entries fired mid-range (meta_rsi 50-58, BTC under EMA300) where there was no trend to follow. Follow-the-trend rule was applied at exit (trail) but not at entry (habitat).

PATTERN 3 — signal-level: losing families (watchdog signal_performance, full history):
ai-trader+ n=29 41% WR -0.80; volume-breakout-long+ n=16 18.8% WR -0.76; bb-bounce-v2-long+ n=36 47.2% WR -0.64; doji-bottom-long n=20 40% WR -0.62; pump-chain- n=36 22.2% WR -0.34; volume-breakout-short- n=3 0% WR -0.37; hmacd_mtf-+ n=8 25% WR -0.46.
WINNING SIDE: the families actually paying are volume-buildup- n=9 77.8% +0.35, r2v2-long3 n=16 56.2% +0.39, bb-squeeze+ n=6 66.7% +0.14, continuum-trend+ n=8 75% 0.00. That is, built-up volume and range-squeeze continuation — trend starts — versus breakout-chasers and bounce-catchers entering mid-chop.
WHY WEREN'T WE ON IT: this is a brain-auditor question (signal weighting), not a watchdog action. Flagged, not acted on — parameter changes are out of scope for this role.

NOT A PATTERN (checked and rejected): the 5m scanner aggregate currently reads LONG_BIAS 20 / SHORT_BIAS 9 / 94 neutral, which contradicts the short-term 15m LONG_BIAS and looks like a "longs are fine" signal. It is not — it counts tokens, not weight, and BTC's own 5m regime is NEUTRAL (conf 64.9, slope 0.005) while it sits below EMA300. Alt-level long bias has repeatedly not survived contact with BTC's trend this cycle.
